metadata.provenance: All scenarios are authored synthetic examples. No real message, person, brand, domain or phone number is used; URLs use reserved .test/.example hosts or documentation IP ranges.
metadata.drafted_by: Drafted with Claude (AI assistant) for @devisripriyanam. Labels have not been reviewed by two teammates.
metadata.label_policy: expected_verdict is the label a careful human reader would assign from the supplied text alone: suspected_scam needs a deceptive pressure, impersonation, or request for a secret or payment; spam is unsolicited promotion; legitimate is an expected notice or ordinary message with no such request; unknown means the supplied evidence is not enough. It is not the output of any detector.
metadata.purpose: 30 development scenarios for building and reviewing the checks. Tuning is allowed here.

input.text: Your Harbor Credit Union verification code is 482913. It expires in 10 minutes. Never share this code with anyone, including our staff.

scenarios.support: Expected OTP delivery that warns the reader not to share the code

input.text: Use 905217 to sign in to your Fernwood account. We will never call or message to ask for this code.

scenarios.support: Second wording of the same OTP-notice template; kept in the same split

input.text: Reminder: your dental check-up is on Tuesday 14 October at 10:30. Reply C to confirm or call the clinic to reschedule.

scenarios.support: Appointment reminder with no request for secrets or payment

input.text: Card ending 4417 was used for $23.80 at Corner Cafe. If this was not you, call the number on the back of your card.

scenarios.support: Transaction alert pointing to the number printed on the card; no link or secret request

input.text: Your Fernwood password was changed today at 09:12. If you did not do this, contact support from the official app.

scenarios.support: Account-change notice without a link or request. Fake notices use this shape, so reviewers must confirm.

input.text: ParcelPoint: your parcel PP-20931 is out for delivery today between 13:00 and 16:00. Track it in the ParcelPoint app.

scenarios.support: Delivery update that points to the app and asks for nothing

input.text: Hi Sam, thanks for applying for the Data Analyst role. Are you free for a 30-minute video interview on Thursday at 11:00?

scenarios.support: Recruiter scheduling an interview; no fee, secret or payment request

input.text: Your order 55821 has shipped. Track it at https://shop.example.test/orders/55821

scenarios.support: Shipping confirmation with a reserved-domain tracking link

input.text: Weekend sale: 30 percent discount on all shoes. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.

scenarios.support: Unsolicited promotion with opt-out wording

input.text: Limited offer: buy one get one free on coffee beans this Saturday. Reply STOP to opt out.

scenarios.support: Second wording of the sale template; kept in the same split

input.text: Last chance: your loyalty points expire tonight. Redeem a free coffee at any store.

scenarios.support: Promotional loyalty reminder with urgency; could be read as a benign notice, so reviewers must confirm.

input.text: Security alert: your wallet is locked. Reply with the 6-digit code we just texted you to unlock it.

scenarios.support: Asks the reader to hand over a one-time code under pressure

input.text: We detected a login from a new device. Confirm your PIN and password by replying to this message.

scenarios.support: Asks the reader to send a PIN and password by message

input.text: ParcelPoint: your parcel is held at the depot. Pay a $1.99 redelivery fee at http://parcelpoint-redeliver.test/pay today or it will be returned.

scenarios.support: Delivery fee demand with a lookalike host and a deadline

input.text: Delivery attempt failed. Update your address and pay the customs fee: http://198.51.100.24/track

scenarios.support: Payment demand pointing at a bare IP-address host

input.text: Congratulations, you are hired as a remote assistant. Send a refundable $120 equipment fee by gift card to start on Monday.

scenarios.support: Job offer that requires an upfront gift-card payment

input.text: Earn $400 a day from home with no interview. Message your bank login details to our recruiter to set up your salary account.

scenarios.support: Job offer that asks for bank login details

input.text: You won the Harbor Prize Draw. Claim your $5,000 reward by entering your card number at http://claim-prize.test/win

scenarios.support: Prize claim that asks for a card number

input.text: A tax refund of $842 is waiting for you. Verify your bank account here: http://203.0.113.9/refund

scenarios.support: Refund lure that asks for bank verification at an IP-address host

input.text: Final notice: unpaid toll of $14.60. Pay within 24 hours to avoid a $200 penalty.

scenarios.support: Payment demand with a deadline and a penalty threat, no verifiable sender

input.text: Hi Mum, I lost my phone. Can you transfer $350 to this new account right now? I will explain later.

scenarios.support: Impersonated relative asking for an urgent transfer to a new account
Benign deep link on a reserved host with a long path and query string
Login-verification path on a bare IP-address host

messages.text: Hi, this is the fraud desk about your card.
Act now, your card will be suspended.
Send your OTP so we can stop the charge.

scenarios.support: One sender escalates from urgency to an OTP request; both messages must be cited

messages.text: Which invoice? I have not received one.
Transfer the money to this wallet immediately.

scenarios.support: Sender pairs urgency with a payment demand; the protected user's reply is excluded

messages.text: Sounds good. Send me the restaurant address and I will book.
It is the Fernwood Bistro on Main Street.

scenarios.support: Ordinary plans; 'send me the address' is not a secret or payment request

messages.text: This is urgent, the offer expires today.
Please send your PIN to confirm the booking.

scenarios.support: Urgency and a secret request come from different senders and must not be combined

input.text: Your parcel is held. Pay the fee now at http://198.51.100.24/pay

scenarios.support: Text check is down while the URL check completes; the partial result must keep the URL evidence

input.text: Confirm your PIN by replying now to keep your account open.

scenarios.support: URL service is down but the message has no link, so the text scam keeps its evidence

input.text: Update your billing details at http://192.0.2.88/billing before midnight.

scenarios.support: Every applicable detector is down; the result must be unknown, never clean or zero risk
